rationale: The Latin anchors — especially *reprobare* ("to reject/condemn"), *repudiare* ("to repudiate"), and *projicere/ejicere* ("to cast away/out") — point to a strong sense of refusing to accept or acknowledge, which aligns best with reject.v.01. The biblical quotations ("ne projicias me" = "do not cast me away"; "oportet filium hominis reprobari" = "the Son of Man must be rejected") confirm a broad, active sense of rejection rather than mere disapproval or immunological resistance.
